canvasSystem.standard: Shelves (proposal 2) is the default presentation. RATIFIED SHELF TEMPLATE (session 6, ported from the Lexicon page): shelf = HORIZONTAL auto layout, pad 40, gap 48, hug both axes, radius 32; left rail = 'index' at FIXED 400 (name + description, both FILL); right rail = 'right' frame at FIXED width, HORIZONTAL + WRAP, hug height, itemSpacing 40, counterAxisSpacing 40, counterAxisAlignItems MIN. Two fixed rails means hug width resolves to one number for every shelf on a surface. Rail width is set per surface by its widest content: ① Components uses 2396, so every shelf there is 2924. Narrower shelves keep the whitespace; they never shrink. Columns group-wrapped so no Figma name labels render. All seven proposal wireframes remain on the Proposed page as the system toolbox.
canvasSystem.componentsShelves: Incomplete(+draft), Active, Resolved, Dismissed, Cancelled, SmartMatch, Signal system, Status badge, Atoms, Identity & ticket, Detail kit. All 2924 wide since session 6.

canvasSystem.protoWorkflow: Native-first, flexible rigs (session 4n): duplicate a rig, resize to ANY device size, swap the screen instance; chrome and screen stretch with the frame (never pick a matching mock). Presentation settings supply the bezel. OTR/Mock/Device + Slot + bench retired to Archive.
canvasSystem.variantGrid: Component sets are storage, laid out as a strict matrix (session 6): rows = one axis, columns = the cross product of the rest, uniform column pitch = set max width + 40, row pitch = tallest variant in the row + 40 (16 when the set's tallest variant is <= 30px), padding 24, layers panel in reading order. Deprecated/hidden variants park in the last rows, never underneath live ones. Set layoutMode must be forced to NONE first - some sets ship with auto layout on and it silently overrides written coordinates.
